$schema-note: Adapter inputs for one corpus build. `corpus build --inputs <path>` reads this file. Every `inputPath` is relative to $MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, resolved at launch.
$overlay-note: This build samples wof-postalcode for the v0.8.6-overlay (#2857). The adapter keeps a row when its hash is among the 5 lowest of its structure cell (country, tag order, name-slot kind) or of its language cell, or among the 90,000 lowest of its country. cell-counts.json beside the build counts every renderable row per cell.
